rules.SEC001: Block recognizable AWS access key IDs, private keys and literal credential assignments; never print matched values.
rules.SEC002: Block credential CSV files in engineering source directories.
rules.VIEW001: Block direct network calls and selected database/cache/object storage SDK imports in Vue views.
rules.LAYER001: Block recognized Go controller-to-dao, service-to-controller and dao-to-service/controller imports.
rules.LAYER002: Block selected direct database/cache/object storage SDK imports in Go controllers.
rules.SQL001: Block explicit SQL locking and database advisory lock calls in SQL/source text.
rules.SQL002: Block recognizable SQL physical deletion and cascading deletion in SQL/source text.
rules.DDL001: Require id, four audit fields and is_deleted in supported CREATE TABLE declarations.
rules.DDL002: Require an independent id primary key and non-null is_deleted defaulting to zero.
rules.DDL003: Require is_deleted as the leading column of supported non-unique composite query indexes.
rules.INPUT001: Fail the static gate when an in-scope file is too large or cannot be read as UTF-8.

manual_rules.REVIEW001: Accurate Chinese/English comments for every handwritten function and method, named business operations, restrained function values and callbacks.
manual_rules.REVIEW002: Complete controller/service/dao separation, object responsibilities, explicit dependencies and all indirect layer paths.
manual_rules.REVIEW003: Separate View and data files; admin Vue 3 is the current implementation proposal, mobile uses Uniapp. Validate reactive local form state and use one transport wrapper per platform; use uni.request on Uniapp.
manual_rules.REVIEW004: MySQL 8.0+; 3NF as design goal, justified 2NF and controlled redundancy; audit behavior, parameterized queries and query plans.
manual_rules.REVIEW005: Soft deletion in all ordinary reads/joins/writes, repeat deletion/recreation/history-safe unique constraints, ORM behavior and migration safety.
manual_rules.REVIEW006: Atomic version-and-state optimistic updates, affected-row checks, bounded conflict handling and no database-as-business-lock usage.
manual_rules.REVIEW007: Every Redis cache write has positive base TTL plus random window, atomic write/expiry, short-lived negative caching and penetration/hot-key protections.
manual_rules.REVIEW008: Object storage environment/business/version key prefixes, versioning/retention/lifecycle, access control and provider-specific behavior.
